title: Load revision helper metadata
responsibility: Reads selected-revision helper, service, model and config declarations, static structures and actual runtime consumers.

inputs.name: configValueStructure.value
inputs.description: Source expression to describe structurally without executing configuration.

inputs.name: configValueStructure.bindings
inputs.description: Local expression bindings that can be followed during static inspection.

inputs.name: configValueStructure.depth
inputs.description: Current recursion depth used to bound structural inspection; defaults to zero.

inputs.name: configValues.text
inputs.description: Committed configuration source text or JSON document to inspect.

inputs.name: configValues.source
inputs.description: Source path used for syntax selection and source-preserving provenance.

inputs.name: declarationRole.kind
inputs.description: Source-declared export/declaration kind, independent of the unit ID and folder-derived kind.

inputs.name: declarationRole.stored
inputs.description: Whether this class owns source-declared storage, including unresolved schema syntax; defaults to false.

inputs.name: modelDefinitions.text
inputs.description: Committed source text containing exported model or type declarations.

inputs.name: modelDefinitions.source
inputs.description: Selected-revision source path used to parse and attribute model definitions.

inputs.name: modelTable.node
inputs.description: Model class declaration whose static storage schema is inspected.

inputs.name: modelTable.file
inputs.description: Parsed source containing the model and source text for unresolved schema expressions.

inputs.name: pureHelperCalls.node
inputs.description: Call expression whose target is checked against admitted pure operations.

inputs.name: pureHelperCalls.local
inputs.description: Locally declared callable names already proven pure.

inputs.name: pureHelpers.code
inputs.description: Source text containing explicitly declared pure helper candidates.

inputs.name: unitMetadata.tree
inputs.description: Reads files from the exact Git revision being viewed.

inputs.name: unitMetadata.units
inputs.description: Registered entities enriched with revision-bound config values, documentation, helpers, service facts and model definitions.

outputs.name: unitMetadata
outputs.description: Attaches selected-revision model methods, fields and literal database schemas alongside config structures, helper contracts and service facts. Source modules and live databases are never executed.
